director.card: Do ek si sadak: pehli team ne 4 barabar hisson mein se 3 banaye, doosri ne 12 mein se 3. Kisne zyada, pehli ya doosri?

seams.form: Ek aur raasta aazmaate hain.

director.text: pehli ne zyada banayi

Sahi jawab. Dono ne teen-teen hisse banaye, par 1/4 ka hissa 1/12 se bada hai, isliye pehli team ne zyada banayi. Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha. Farhan ne chocolate ka 2/7 khaya aur Isha ne 2/3, toh zyada kisne khaya?
director.card: Tumhari baari: zyada kisne khaya, Farhan ne ya Isha ne?

seams.form: Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha.

director.text: Isha ne khaya

Haan, sahi hai: line par 2/3 ka mark 2/7 ke mark se kaafi aage hai. Toh poora jawab: Isha ne, 2/3. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: ek ka 4/5 liya, ek ka 4/9, aur ek ka 4/7. In teeno ko chhote se bade tak order mein lagao.
director.card: Teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: ek ka 4/5 liya, ek ka 4/9, aur ek ka 4/7. In teeno ko chhote se bade tak order mein lagao.

seams.form: Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari.

director.text: Nahi, 4/5, 4/7, 4/9 theek nahi. Order chhote se bade ka maanga hai. Teeno se 4-4 hisse liye hain; pehle socho kis chocolate ka ek hissa sabse patla hai. Teen ek jaisi chocolate se 4/5, 4/9 aur 4/7 liya; inhe chhote se bade tak kis order mein lagaoge?
director.card: Teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: ek ka 4/5 liya, ek ka 4/9, aur ek ka 4/7. In teeno ko chhote se bade tak order mein lagao.

director.text: Bilkul sahi, kyunki teeno mein 4 hisse, par 1/9 ka hissa sabse chhota aur 1/5 ka sabse bada; isliye 4/9, phir 4/7, phir 4/5. Anjali aur Imran ke paas ek jaise ribbon hain. Anjali apna ribbon 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, Imran apna 6 mein kaatkar 5. Kisne zyada ribbon liya, Anjali ne ya Imran ne?
director.card: Anjali aur Imran ke paas ek jaise ribbon hain. Anjali apna ribbon 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, Imran apna 6 mein kaatkar 5. Kisne zyada ribbon liya, Anjali ne ya Imran ne?

director.text: Imran

Haan, bilkul theek. Dono ke paanch-paanch hisse, par Imran ka har hissa Anjali ke hisse ka do guna hai. Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Dono mein poore pizza se bas ek-ek hissa kam hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?
director.card: Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Dono mein poore pizza se bas ek-ek hissa kam hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?

director.text: 8/9 hai na

Sahi jawab, kyunki 8/9 poore se bas 1/9 kam hai, 6/7 poore se 1/7 kam, aur 1/9 chhota hai. Ab poore paath ko yaad karke bas ek sawaal aur karna hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
12/7 sahi nahi hai. Dono mein 7 hisse liye gaye; ab dekho kis patti ka ek hissa chhota hai. 7/10 aur 7/12, dono ek jaisi patti ke hain; inmein se chhota kaun hai?
Nahi, 12/7 theek nahi. Dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi kaise, bas laga

Achha, sun liya maine. Aaj dekha ki ek poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse, har hissa utna chhota. Hisse ek size ke hon toh ginti dekhte hain, aur ginti barabar ho toh hisse ka size. Aaj ka kaam aasaan laga ya thoda mushkil?
thoda mushkil tha
Theek hai, samajh gayi. Aaj ke paath mein tumne dekha ki 6/7 aur 8/9 mein poore ke zyada paas kaun. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
